item.title: Apple’s upcoming AI smart glasses are starting to sound a lot more exciting

item.title: Report: Apple to launch ‘at least five products’ leading into March 4 event

item.title: Apple should take Visual Intelligence one step further – with Reminders
item.description: One of the core Apple Intelligence features to date has been Visual Intelligence. I’ve found those capabilities very useful thus far, and I’d love to see Apple take it even further. more…
